Blood Frenzy.note: Resource loop: crits give Rage in Bear Form and extra combo points in Cat Form. Sharpened Claws and Leader of the Pack add crit.

Furor.note: Resource loop: shapeshift into Bear for Rage, or back into Cat keeping your Energy (plus some).

Predatory Strikes.note: Feral Attack Power that grows with your level.

Leader of the Pack.note: Group buff: +3% crit for the party while you are in a feral form.

Rend and Tear.note: Combo: keep Rake or Rip up, then everything else hits harder.

Predatory Discipline.note: Ferocious Bite no longer eats your extra Energy.

Thick Hide.note: Tanking: more base armor in forms.

Natural Reaction.note: Resource loop: dodges in Bear Form give Rage.

Nature's Grace.note: Proc chain: spell crit → faster casts for 3 sec.

Eclipse.note: Combo: Wrath charges up faster Starfires (up to 4 charges).

Bloom.note: Rejuvenation and Regrowth heal again when they expire, based on your Spirit.

Wild Growth.note: Group heal over time that front-loads its healing.
